items.title: Bind M2 launch authorization and dated snapshot inputs
items.context: Create provider-free M2 readiness artifacts that record the approval boundary, E1/E2 provider-family snapshots, host/model separation, and provider execution state.
items.userSees: A status artifact explains which launch blockers are cleared and which still require actual provider execution.

happy.desc: Checker accepts readiness artifacts with explicit approval boundary, distinct E1/E2 provider families, dated snapshot records, and provider execution disabled.

edge.desc: Checker distinguishes readiness approval from provider-execution authorization and keeps formalPhase1UseAllowed false until all execution prerequisites are present.

adversarial.desc: Checker rejects treating host labels as model families, missing dated snapshots, provider calls enabled without explicit execution authorization, or outcome data inside readiness artifacts.

verificationEvidence.note: M2 checker passed with 730 assertions and 15 negative controls; it accepts readiness artifacts with the 2026-07-05 approval boundary, distinct E1/E2 provider families, dated readiness declarations, and provider execution disabled.
Checker distinguishes readiness approval from provider-execution authorization: providerExecutionAuthorized, phase1CampaignAuthorized, formalPhase1UseAllowed, and providerCallEnabled remain false.
Negative controls reject host labels as model families, missing dated snapshots, enabled provider calls without execution authorization, outcome fields, and records paths inside readiness artifacts.

items.title: Bind the concrete 24-task inventory and Phase 1 runner manifest
items.context: Create the M2 task inventory and launch manifest needed before formal cells can run, preserving the M1 cell matrix and legal contrast rules without changing task definitions.
items.userSees: The launch-readiness report shows whether the 24 task slots are concrete and whether required cells ③, ⑥, and ② are ready to schedule.
excludes: Modifying experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/**; this path is read-only canonical source for inventory binding

happy.desc: Checker accepts exactly 24 concrete task entries and required Phase 1 cells ③/⑥/② with deterministic seed linkage.

edge.desc: Optional ④ may be absent while required Phase 1 launch remains structurally valid.

adversarial.desc: Checker rejects missing task entries, duplicated task ids, changed task definitions, illegal ② vs ④ confirmatory comparison, or duplicate runner ownership of the same cellKey.

verificationEvidence.note: M2 checker passed with 730 assertions; it recomputes the read-only task inventory and accepts exactly 24 unique task directories bound by corpus digest, plus required Phase 1 cells ③/⑥/② with deterministic cell family linkage.
Checker accepts required Phase 1 readiness while ④ remains optional_budget_permitting and requiredForLaunchReadiness=false.
Negative controls reject missing tasks, duplicate task ids, changed task digests, illegal ②-vs-④ confirmatory use, and duplicate runner ownership of the same cell family.

items.title: Preserve A4 budget-lock and A2prime sequencing discipline
items.context: M2 Launch Readiness must not fake the ③-derived A4 calibration budget lock. It should show that ⑥ remains blocked until ordered M2-a execution produces a real budget lock.
relatedDocs: docs/requirements/decisions/multi-model-ablation-replication.md#34-控制变量与-v1-逐条对齐--修复项
items.userSees: The status table says static launch readiness is prepared while ③ calibration and ⑥ A2prime remain ordered execution steps.
excludes: Using M0 example budget locks as formal M2 evidence

happy.desc: Checker reports A4 calibration required before A2prime and does not mark A2prime sequencing satisfied in readiness-only mode.

edge.desc: A readiness artifact may be DONE while budgetLockStatus remains pending_execution.

adversarial.desc: Checker rejects any artifact that marks A2prime sequencing satisfied without a real phase1 budget lock bound to ③ calibration records.

verificationEvidence.note: M2 checker passed and confirms ③ A4 calibration is pending_execution and required before any ⑥ A2prime budget lock.
Checker accepts M2 readiness as DONE-compatible while budgetLockStatus remains pending_execution and formal Phase 1 execution remains disabled.

Negative controls reject any artifact that marks ⑥ A2prime sequencing satisfied or executionAllowed=true without a real ③-derived budget lock; M0 example budget locks are not accepted as formal evidence.

items.title: Update M2 status reporting and protocol progress table
items.context: Make the milestone state obvious: M0 and M1 are done, M2 launch readiness is provider-free, M2 execution has not started, and M3-M6 remain pending.
items.userSees: A readable table lists every milestone, what is done, what is blocked, and what evidence exists.

happy.desc: m2-status.md prints a milestone table with M0/M1 done, M2 readiness prepared, M2 execution not started, and M3-M6 pending.

edge.desc: Status remains accurate if optional ④ is not scheduled.

adversarial.desc: Status text must not claim outcome data exists, Phase 1 has run, or model-agnostic claims are proven.
